description: Angular component for health status dashboard, fetching and displaying health check data with auto-refresh.

classes.name: HealthComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing health status display, including periodic refresh and status computation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up auto-refresh timer, and performs initial health fetch.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscription on component destruction.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Manually triggers a health status refresh from the health service.

methods.name: applyResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a health check, updating signals accordingly.

methods.name: formatDurationSeconds
methods.description: Formats a duration in seconds into a human-readable string.
